market_context: The Nasdaq-100 rose 0.91% to 28,437.17 (QQQ +0.97% to $691.95) as Democrats’ midterm sweep fueled a megacap/hyperscaler rally on hopes of slower data-center capex, while chip, memory and storage names sold off on Texas/data-center moratorium fears.
market_cap_basis: Shares outstanding x 2026-11-04 close. Shares implied from Nasdaq market caps as of the 2026-10-29 close (watchlist market_cap_usd / 2026-10-29 close), so multi-class companies (e.g. GOOGL) reflect all share classes.
